{{Top}}
'''Phosphorus''' was a native gas to the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of [[Almas]] before it was converted to [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]. It was also used in flares due to the intensely bright light it produced. [[Lignan crystal]]s also contained phosphorus.
